description.value: Sushi Zion is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant in Surrey serving sushi alongside Korean-Japanese fusion dishes. The compact spot offers both dine-in and take-out, and supports online ordering with a loyalty points program. It sits along the 168 Street corridor in the Cloverdale area of Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sushi Zion is a real, active Japanese/Korean restaurant at 10422 168 St, Surrey, BC, matching the OSM address and phone number. The website explicitly references 'take-out orders' in the discount notice, confirming takeout service. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those are left null. One minor discrepancy: OSM lists hours as Tu-Sa only, but the website shows Sunday hours as well (closed only Monday).
concerns: OSM opening_hours lists Tu-Sa only (implying closed Sunday), but the website lists Sunday hours (11:45 AM – 8:00 PM, closed only Monday). OSM hours appear incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and takeout service — a useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Surrey.
